relationships.subject: [11C]TMI
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the baseline binding was blocked using meloxicam, which indicates specific binding to COX-2 in the brain.

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas COX-2 is induced by growth factors and proinflammatory cytokines and it is responsible for prostaglandin production during inflammation.

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS is an important tool for studying neuroinflammation and has been used to produce a signal on COX-2 that is detectable by PET scanning [41].

key_findings: Review of radiolabeled COX-2 inhibitors for PET imaging of neuroinflammation; [11C]TMI, [11C]MC1 and [18F]MTP are the most promising BBB-permeable tracers.
COX-2 is considered a better PET neuroinflammation target than TSPO, P2X7R and CB2 owing to their limitations.
